about: Theme words for the theme-statement check: the words a character would use to say the game's argument out loud (bible 1 and 11).
setting_note: Gullet (Low Water's first setting). Lamb, Gullet and the harbour are cut as setting and protagonist (QUOTA-DESIGN.md decision 3, 2026-10-21); kept for the archived acts and for VOICE-AUDIT.md re-runs. The Quota's sheets are in design/voice-sheets/quota/.
